environment.en: Everyone has a duty to protect the environment for future generations.
environment.zh: 每个人都有责任为子孙后代保护环境。

environmental.en: Environmental problems cannot be solved by any one country alone.
environmental.zh: 环境问题不是任何一个国家能单独解决的。

pollution.en: Pollution from factories is damaging rivers and lakes across the region.
pollution.zh: 工厂造成的污染正在破坏该地区的河流和湖泊。

pollutant.en: Factories should be required to reduce the pollutants they release into rivers.
pollutant.zh: 应要求工厂减少排入河流的污染物。

contaminate.en: Chemicals used on farms can contaminate drinking water supplies.
contaminate.zh: 农场使用的化学品可能污染饮用水源。

air-pollution.en: Air pollution is a major cause of breathing problems in large cities.
air-pollution.zh: 空气污染是大城市呼吸问题的主要原因。

water-pollution.en: Water pollution from mines has killed most of the fish in the river.
water-pollution.zh: 矿山造成的水污染杀死了河里的大部分鱼。

noise-pollution.en: Noise pollution from aircraft can damage the health of nearby residents.
noise-pollution.zh: 飞机造成的噪音污染可能损害附近居民的健康。

light-pollution.en: Light pollution in cities makes it difficult to see the stars at night.
light-pollution.zh: 城市的光污染使人们夜间很难看到星星。

smog.en: Thick smog forced the government to close schools for several days.
smog.zh: 浓重的雾霾迫使政府关闭学校数日。

exhaust.en: Exhaust from cars is one of the main sources of air pollution.
exhaust.zh: 汽车尾气是空气污染的主要来源之一。

exhaust.en: Humans may exhaust the planet's supplies of oil within this century.
exhaust.zh: 人类可能在本世纪内耗尽地球的石油储量。

fumes.en: Traffic fumes are particularly harmful to young children walking to school.
fumes.zh: 交通废气对步行上学的幼儿尤其有害。

waste.en: Most household waste could be recycled if people sorted it properly.
waste.zh: 如果人们正确分类,大部分生活垃圾都可以回收。

waste.en: Many people waste water by leaving taps running while they brush their teeth.
waste.zh: 许多人刷牙时不关水龙头,浪费了水。

landfill.en: Most of the city's rubbish still goes to landfill outside the town.
landfill.zh: 这座城市的大部分垃圾仍被送往城外的垃圾填埋场。

incineration.en: Incineration reduces the amount of waste but can release harmful gases.
incineration.zh: 焚化能减少废物量,但可能释放有害气体。

rubbish.en: People should be fined for leaving rubbish on the beach.
rubbish.zh: 在海滩上留下垃圾的人应该被罚款。

litter.en: Litter in the streets makes a city look dirty and uncared for.
litter.zh: 街道上的垃圾使城市看起来又脏又没人管。

litter.en: People who litter in public parks should be made to pay a fine.
litter.zh: 在公园乱扔垃圾的人应该被罚款。

disposable.en: Disposable products create huge amounts of waste that do not break down.
disposable.zh: 一次性产品产生大量无法分解的废物。

plastic-bag.en: A single plastic bag can take hundreds of years to break down.
plastic-bag.zh: 一个塑料袋可能需要数百年才能分解。

packaging.en: Supermarkets should reduce the amount of packaging used on their food.
packaging.zh: 超市应该减少食品的包装用量。

biodegradable.en: Biodegradable materials could replace much of the plastic used today.
biodegradable.zh: 可生物降解材料可以取代今天使用的大部分塑料。

recycling.en: Recycling should be compulsory for all homes and businesses.
recycling.zh: 所有家庭和企业都应强制进行回收。

reuse.en: Families should reuse glass bottles rather than throw them away.
reuse.zh: 家庭应该重复使用玻璃瓶,而不是扔掉。

carbon-footprint.en: Eating less meat is an easy way to reduce your carbon footprint.
carbon-footprint.zh: 少吃肉是减少碳足迹的简单方法。

carbon-neutral.en: The city aims to become carbon neutral within the next twenty years.
carbon-neutral.zh: 这座城市的目标是在未来二十年内实现碳中和。

low-carbon.en: Governments should encourage a low-carbon economy through taxes and subsidies.
low-carbon.zh: 政府应该通过税收和补贴鼓励低碳经济。

eco-friendly.en: More consumers are willing to pay extra for eco-friendly products.
eco-friendly.zh: 越来越多的消费者愿意为环保产品多付钱。

green.en: Green policies should be at the centre of every government's plans.
green.zh: 环保政策应该成为每个政府计划的核心。

clean-energy.en: Investing in clean energy would create jobs and reduce air pollution.
clean-energy.zh: 投资清洁能源既能创造就业机会,又能减少空气污染。

alternative-energy.en: Investment in alternative energy would reduce our dependence on fossil fuels.
alternative-energy.zh: 投资替代能源将减少我们对化石燃料的依赖。

energy-efficient.en: New homes should be energy-efficient in order to reduce household bills.
energy-efficient.zh: 新房应该节能,以减少家庭开支。

resource.en: Water is a precious resource that should not be wasted.
resource.zh: 水是一种宝贵的资源,不应被浪费。

natural-resources.en: Developed countries consume far more than their fair share of natural resources.
natural-resources.zh: 发达国家消耗的自然资源远远超过了它们应得的份额。

finite.en: Oil is a finite resource that will eventually run out.
finite.zh: 石油是一种有限的资源,最终会用完。

depletion.en: The depletion of fish stocks threatens the jobs of many coastal communities.
depletion.zh: 鱼类资源的枯竭威胁着许多沿海社区的就业。

deplete.en: Modern farming methods can deplete the soil of its natural nutrients.
deplete.zh: 现代耕作方法可能耗尽土壤的天然养分。

scarcity.en: Water scarcity is likely to become a major cause of international conflict.
scarcity.zh: 缺水可能成为国际冲突的主要原因。

shortage.en: A shortage of affordable housing is forcing young people out of the city.
shortage.zh: 经济适用房的短缺正把年轻人赶出城市。

ecological-balance.en: Removing a single species can upset the ecological balance of an area.
ecological-balance.zh: 移除单个物种可能破坏一个地区的生态平衡。

degradation.en: Environmental degradation can have serious effects on human health.
degradation.zh: 环境退化可能严重影响人类健康。

desertification.en: Overgrazing and climate change are the main causes of desertification.
desertification.zh: 过度放牧和气候变化是荒漠化的主要原因。

soil-erosion.en: Cutting down trees on hillsides can lead to serious soil erosion.
soil-erosion.zh: 砍伐山坡上的树木可能导致严重的水土流失。

acid-rain.en: Acid rain has damaged forests and lakes across northern Europe.
acid-rain.zh: 酸雨破坏了北欧各地的森林和湖泊。

climate-change.en: Climate change is the most serious environmental problem facing the world.
climate-change.zh: 气候变化是世界面临的最严重的环境问题。

natural-disaster.en: Poor countries are often the worst affected by a natural disaster.
natural-disaster.zh: 贫穷国家往往受自然灾害的影响最严重。

catastrophe.en: Scientists warn of a catastrophe if the ice sheets continue to melt.
catastrophe.zh: 科学家警告,如果冰盖继续融化,将发生灾难。

irreversible.en: The damage to the world's coral reefs may already be irreversible.
irreversible.zh: 世界珊瑚礁所受的损害可能已经不可逆转。

preservation.en: The preservation of old forests should be a priority for every government.
preservation.zh: 保护古老森林应该是每个政府的优先事项。

environmentalist.en: An environmentalist would argue that economic growth is not always a good thing.
environmentalist.zh: 环保主义者会认为经济增长并不总是好事。

wildlife-reserve.en: A wildlife reserve gives rare animals a safe place to live and breed.
wildlife-reserve.zh: 野生动物保护区为珍稀动物提供了安全的生活和繁殖场所。

national-park.en: Visitor numbers to the national park should be limited to protect wildlife.
national-park.zh: 应该限制国家公园的游客数量,以保护野生动物。

pollute.en: Factories that pollute rivers should have to pay for the clean-up.
pollute.zh: 污染河流的工厂应该支付清理费用。

polluted.en: Children living in polluted cities are more likely to suffer from asthma.
polluted.zh: 生活在污染城市的孩子更容易患哮喘。

contamination.en: Contamination of food can lead to serious illness among consumers.
contamination.zh: 食品污染可能导致消费者患上严重疾病。

contaminated.en: Drinking contaminated water is a major cause of death in poor countries.
contaminated.zh: 饮用受污染的水是贫穷国家的主要死因。

poisonous.en: Burning plastic releases poisonous gases into the air.
poisonous.zh: 焚烧塑料会向空气中释放有毒气体。

noxious.en: Noxious gases from the factory have damaged the health of local people.
noxious.zh: 工厂排出的有害气体损害了当地人的健康。

discharge.en: Factories must not discharge untreated waste into local rivers.
discharge.zh: 工厂不得向当地河流排放未经处理的废物。

sewerage.en: Many poor neighbourhoods still have no proper sewerage system.
sewerage.zh: 许多贫困社区仍然没有完善的排污系统。

decibel.en: Noise above eighty-five decibels can damage people's hearing over time.
decibel.zh: 超过八十五分贝的噪音长期下来会损害听力。

deterioration.en: The deterioration of air quality is a serious concern in many large cities.
deterioration.zh: 空气质量恶化是许多大城市严重关切的问题。

harm.en: Some pesticides do more harm than good in the long term.
harm.zh: 从长远来看,有些农药弊大于利。

harm.en: Light from buildings can harm birds that migrate at night.
harm.zh: 建筑物的灯光可能伤害夜间迁徙的鸟类。

vivisection.en: Some people believe vivisection is cruel and should be banned.
vivisection.zh: 有些人认为活体解剖很残忍,应该被禁止。

sustainable-development.en: Sustainable development meets present needs without harming future generations.
sustainable-development.zh: 可持续发展既满足当前需要,又不损害子孙后代。

carbon-emissions.en: Taxes on air travel could help to reduce carbon emissions.
carbon-emissions.zh: 对航空旅行征税有助于减少碳排放。

energy-consumption.en: Better insulation would greatly reduce energy consumption in older homes.
energy-consumption.zh: 更好的隔热层将大大减少老房子的能源消耗。

waste-disposal.en: Waste disposal is becoming a serious problem for fast-growing cities.
waste-disposal.zh: 废物处理正成为快速发展城市的严重问题。

waste-water.en: Waste water from the factory must be cleaned before it reaches the river.
waste-water.zh: 工厂废水流入河流前必须经过净化。

water-shortage.en: Water shortage is already a serious problem in many dry regions.
water-shortage.zh: 缺水已是许多干旱地区的严重问题。

wind-energy.en: Wind energy is now one of the cheapest sources of electricity.
wind-energy.zh: 风能现在是最便宜的电力来源之一。

disaster.en: The oil spill was an environmental disaster for the whole coast.
disaster.zh: 这次石油泄漏对整个海岸来说是一场环境灾难。

survival.en: The survival of many species depends on protecting their natural homes.
survival.zh: 许多物种的生存取决于保护它们的自然家园。

garbage.en: Garbage from cities is often shipped to poorer countries for disposal.
garbage.zh: 城市垃圾常常被运到较贫穷的国家处理。

dump.en: Companies should not be allowed to dump chemical waste in the sea.
dump.zh: 不应允许公司向海里倾倒化学废物。

dump.en: The old rubbish dump outside the town has been turned into a park.
dump.zh: 镇外的旧垃圾场被改造成了公园。

spill.en: The oil spill killed thousands of sea birds along the coast.
spill.zh: 这次石油泄漏导致沿海数千只海鸟死亡。

spill.en: Tankers sometimes spill oil into the sea when they are damaged.
spill.zh: 油轮受损时有时会把石油泄漏到海里。

evacuate.en: Thousands of people had to evacuate their homes because of the flood.
evacuate.zh: 洪水迫使数千人疏散离家。

debris.en: Plastic debris in the ocean kills large numbers of sea animals.
debris.zh: 海洋中的塑料碎片杀死了大量海洋动物。

devastate.en: Rising sea levels could devastate low-lying countries such as Bangladesh.
devastate.zh: 海平面上升可能摧毁孟加拉国等低洼国家。

wreck.en: Oil from the wreck spread along the coast for many miles.
wreck.zh: 残骸漏出的石油沿海岸扩散了许多英里。
